<b>Pickled Muckmaggot</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Pickled Muckmaggot is one of the five ingredients required for the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> wish. It is given to [[Loyal Mergwin]] in the [[Choral Chambers]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Loyal Mergwin 01.png!Loyal Mergwin's location in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Loyal Mergwin 02.png!Loyal Mergwin in Choral Chambers
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Pickled Muckmaggot is dropped by [[Disgraced Chef Lugoli]] when they are defeated. Reaching the boss requires the [[Faydown Cloak]]. 

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Disgraced Chef Lugoli 01.png!Location in Sinner's Road
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Disgraced Chef Lugoli 10.png! Disgraced Chef Lugoli in Sinner's Road
}}

== Trivia ==
* The internal name for the graphic of the Pickled Muckmaggot, <code>century_maggot_icon</code>, is likely a reference to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Century_egg| Century Eggs], which are aged fowl eggs.
